statement: GPT-5.6 Luna xhigh under the exact read-only Codex 0.147.0 realization may independently review one bounded eval-selection return with evidence discipline and scope restraint, but this remains a real-work canary hypothesis until the present reviewer duty returns and is filtered.

conditions: the writer result, model report, selected output, task contract and target owner are exact immutable inputs
the current aoa-evals source and the review done state are inspectable
the reviewer has a separate identity, thread and read-only environment
the reviewer may confirm or return for repair but cannot mutate or self-accept the writer result
owner acceptance, eval design, eval execution and model-fit admission remain outside the mandate
the exact Codex 0.147.0 realization and admitted abyss-stack read-only profile are bound before launch
usage is counted from runtime receipts and is not constrained by a caller-authored execution budget
exclusions: repairing writer source, report or output
inventing a rubric, eval, metric, proof verdict or owner meaning
issuing aoa-evals owner acceptance or a model-fit conclusion
autonomous commit, push, merge, publication, network access or external effects
treating the writer's successful transport as correctness evidence
inferring closed-model internal geometry or training lineage from behavior

evidence_refs.notes: This proves that one separate Luna evaluator produced and returned a bounded selection under the writer contour. It supplies real review material but does not prove reviewer-role fit.
Adjacent read-only external-review evidence only; landing fit does not transfer as eval-review proof.
Confirms the exact Luna xhigh realization under Codex 0.147.0; it is compatibility evidence, not role-fit evidence.

freshness.policy: Current only to authorize one evidence-complete real-work eval-review canary; its filtered return must strengthen, narrow, weaken or stale this claim.

history.reason: A real bounded evaluator return plus adjacent read-only Luna evidence justify one independent-review canary, not transferred proof.

attribution_limits: No Luna eval-review run under this exact claim has completed.
The writer return proves useful review material and transport only, not reviewer correctness or net benefit.
Landing read-only evidence is adjacent and cannot establish eval-review fit.
A successful canary remains subject to goal-master filtering and aoa-evals owner authority.
Behavior cannot establish closed-model internal geometry or training lineage.
